description: This file defines the SparkConf class used for configuring Spark applications, including setting and retrieving configuration parameters, environment variables, and generating debug strings.

classes.name: SparkConf
classes.description: Class for configuring Spark applications with methods to set, get, and manage configuration parameters.

methods.name: setIfMissing
methods.description: Set a configuration property if it is not already set.

methods.name: setExecutorEnv
methods.description: Set environment variables for executors, either a single key-value pair or multiple pairs.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Set multiple configuration parameters from a list of key-value pairs.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve the value for a given configuration key.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Check if a configuration key exists.

methods.name: toDebugString
methods.description: Generate a string representation of all configuration parameters.
